title: Enrolment Response
description: Server response to an enrolment request. Status is enrolled, refused, or pending.

device_id.description: Unique device identifier. Present only when status is enrolled.

certificate.description: Base64url-encoded X.509 DER device certificate. Present only when status is enrolled.

ca_chain.description: Base64url-encoded DER certificates for the intermediate and root CA, in order. Present only when status is enrolled.

cert_expires_at.description: Unix timestamp of certificate expiry. Present only when status is enrolled.

config_version.description: Current authoritative config version. Present only when status is enrolled.

error_code.description: Machine-readable error code. Present when status is refused or pending.

error_message.description: Human-readable error description. Present when status is refused or pending.
